token.title: 🔑 Alamar shiga ta GitHub
token.intro: GitHub yana amsa buƙatu 60 a sa'a ga adireshin da ba ya aika alamar shiga. Cikakken bishiyar fork yana cin kusan 32, don haka a ziyara ta biyu sai ya ƙare. Alamar shiga tana ɗaga rufin zuwa 5000 a sa'a.
token.step1: Buɗe Settings, Developer settings, Personal access tokens, Fine-grained tokens, sannan Generate new token.
token.step2: Resource owner: asusunka na kanka. Expiration: kowace rana, bishiyar ba ta buƙatar wani abu mai daɗewa.
token.step4: Kada ka taɓa kowane izini. Bayanan ma'ajiyar jama'a ba sa buƙatar ko ɗaya daga cikinsu.
token.step5: Ƙirƙira, sannan kwafi ƙimar {token}. GitHub yana nuna ta sau ɗaya kacal.
token.classic: Alamar shiga ta gargajiya ma tana aiki: ƙirƙiri ɗaya ba tare da zaɓar wata iyaka ba. Iyaka mara komai tana karanta bayanan jama'a a ma'aunin da aka tabbatar.
token.stays: Yana zama a wannan burauza ƙarƙashin maɓalli {key} kuma yana tafiya zuwa {host} kawai. Ba a taɓa rubuta shi a sandar adireshi ba, don haka mahaɗin da ka raba yana ɗauke da kallon ba takardar shaidar ba. Maɓallin da ke ƙarƙashin filin yana sake goge shi tare da ma'ajiyar wucin gadi.
token.persistHow: Saka alamar shiga a fayil ɗin {env} na sabar da ke ɗaukar wannan shafi, kusa da {port}:
token.proxy: sannan ka fara shi da {make}. Kwantena daga nan zai rubuta gutsuren nginx wanda ke haɗa kan {header} ga wakilin {path}, don haka burauza tana kiran asalinta kuma ba ta taɓa karɓar alamar shiga ba. Wannan filin yana ɓacewa kuma kowane baƙo yana raba kasafi ɗaya na 5000 a sa'a.
fork.refused404: Babu layukan rassa: {message}. 404 a nan ko dai reshe ne da babu shi ko hanya ce da wakilin sabar ba ya ɗauka; hanyar sadarwar fork da ke sama cikakkiya ce ko ta yaya.
fork.refusedExhausted: Buƙatun GitHub sun ƙare na wannan sa'a, don haka ba a iya zana layukan rassa ba. Hanyar sadarwar fork da ke sama cikakkiya ce. Ƙara alamar shiga a allon tacewa, ko kashe layukan rassa a allon zane don kashe kasafin a kan hanyar sadarwa kawai.
fork.refusedOther: GitHub ya amsa da {status} ga tarihin ƙaddamarwa, don haka ba a iya zana layukan rassa ba. Hanyar sadarwar fork da ke sama cikakkiya ce.
fork.tagsOrphaned: Tambari ba shi da kwanan wata, don haka sauran kowanne zai ci buƙata wadda ragowar kasafin sa'ar ba a kashe shi a kanta ba.
fork.axisZoomed: {axis}, tagar ƙaddamarwa da tambura da aka loda. Layukan fork da suka girmi haka ana manne su a gefen hagu.
fork.axisWhole: {axis}. Buɗe ma'ajiya don zana hanyoyin ƙaddamarwarta da haɗe-haɗenta; gatari zai taƙaita zuwa wannan tarihi.
